title: 第1章 降妻为妾第2章 柔软下的坚硬
lines: “阿缨……给我个孩儿罢……”
锦被之下，绣枕之间，尽是恩爱的痕迹，她的指下是他温热起伏的背脊。
谢容一遍遍抚过她的小腹，声音哑得厉害，带着情极前的忍耐。
恍惚中，她倦慵地嘤咛一声，尾音被碾碎在唇齿间。
她仰颈承吻，藕臂不自觉环上他汗湿的脖颈，青丝交缠于枕上，异样一点点攀升，任馀韵在四肢百骸流淌，似有暖意在情潮最浓时悄然扎根，结下他的骨血。
“娘亲，你看我给爹爹做的笔筒！”
小儿清亮的话语将戴缨从遥远的记忆拉回，接着，墙那头响起柔婉的女声。
“逸儿手巧，你爹爹准喜欢。”
听着这声音，戴缨正欲够茶壶的手一顿，那是一双瘦得能看见皮下静伏得青紫筋络的手，又枯又柴。
就在怔愣时，记忆中那道温静的声音响起，扯得她心尖生疼。
“难为我儿心意，爹爹喜欢。”
接着是下人们躬敬地唤“大爷。”
戴缨将手颤巍巍收回，归雁端着汤药进来，眼框发红：“娘子，药好了。”
“那小儿是逸哥儿？”
戴缨没看药，目光注视在院墙上。
“是，大爷和主母最小的哥儿。”
归雁把药搁在桌案上，心里发堵，郎心似铁，却比铁更冷硬，曾经那样的宠爱，眼里心里只她家娘子一人，如今却……
戴缨抓起药碗，面无表情地灌下去，苦涩漫满喉咙：“下去罢。”
归雁看着那单薄的背影，终究没敢多说。
屋门关上，戴缨把骼膊搭在窗栏上，日光下，她的皮肤薄得近乎透明。
她知道自己活不久了，这稀烂的日子，也没什么好留恋的。
弥留之际，过往在眼前闪得飞快。
她是平谷戴家的女儿，戴万昌的长女，戴家虽说是商贾，却在平谷富甲一方，她和谢容的婚约，是因姑母戴万如。
当年戴万如执意嫁给穷书生谢山，谢山科举、仕途打点全靠戴万昌出钱，戴万昌图的是日后谢山出仕能帮着抬一抬戴家的地位。
后来谢山在京做了七品都事，戴缨就和谢容订了娃娃亲。
十六岁那年，戴缨和谢容本要议亲，戴母却突然病逝，她守孝三年，婚事拖到十九岁。
孝期一满，谢家便派人来接她进京。
初进谢府时，姑母待她亲厚，表妹谢珍一口一个“表姐”
，谢容更是温柔体贴，常如儿时一样逗弄她。
然而，不知从哪一日起，一切都变了。
“兄长是不是结识了枢密使家的陆娘子？”
她问过谢容。
“莫要多想，都是下人乱传。”
content_en:
"A Ying... just give me a child..."
Under the brocade quilt and between the embroidered pillows, there were all traces of love. Under her fingers, he felt the warm undulations of his back.
Xie Rong caressed her belly over and over again, his voice was extremely hoarse, and he was filled with extreme patience.
In a daze, she let out a tired cry, the last sound of which was crushed between her lips and teeth.
She tilted her neck up to receive the kiss, and unconsciously wrapped her arms around his sweaty neck. Her black hair was tangled on the pillow, climbing up little by little, letting the lingering charm flow through her limbs, as if warmth quietly took root when the tide of love was at its strongest, forming a knot in his bones and blood.
"Mom, look at the pen holder I made for daddy!"
Xiao'er's clear words brought Dai Ying back from her distant memory, and then, a soft female voice sounded from the other side of the wall.
"Yi'er is very handy, your dad will definitely like it."
Listening to this voice, Dai Ying was about to reach for the teapot's hand. It was a pair of hands so thin that you could see the purple veins lying under the skin. They were withered and dry.
Just when she was stunned, the gentle voice in her memory sounded, making her heart ache.
"It's hard for my son to please me. Daddy likes it."
Then the servants respectfully called "Uncle."
Dai Ying took back her trembling hand, and Gui Yan came in with the soup and medicine, her eyes red: "Madam, the medicine is ready."
"That kid is Brother Yi?"
Dai Ying didn't take the medicine and stared at the courtyard wall.
"Yes, the youngest brother of the uncle and mistress."
Gui Yan put the medicine on the table, feeling blocked in her heart. Her husband's heart was like iron, but even colder than iron. She used to be so doting on her, and only her wife was the only one in her eyes, but now...
Dai Ying grabbed the medicine bowl and drank it down expressionlessly. The bitterness filled her throat: "Go down."
Gui Yan looked at the thin back and did not dare to say anything.
The door was closed, and Dai Ying put her arms on the window railing. Under the sunlight, her skin was so thin that it was almost transparent.
She knew that she would not live long, and there was nothing to miss in these miserable days.
As he lay dying, the past flashed before his eyes.
She is the daughter of the Dai family in Pinggu and the eldest daughter of Dai Wanchang. Although the Dai family is a businessman, they are one of the richest in Pinggu. Her engagement with Xie Rong was due to her aunt Dai Wanru.
At that time, Dai Wanru insisted on marrying poor scholar Xie Shan. Xie Shan's imperial examination and career management were all funded by Dai Wanchang. Dai Wanchang hoped that Xie Shan's official career would help improve the Dai family's status in the future.
Later, Xie Shan worked as a seventh-level official in Beijing, and Dai Ying arranged a baby engagement with Xie Rong.
When Dai Ying was sixteen years old, Dai Ying and Xie Rong were planning to get married, but Dai's mother suddenly died of illness. She stayed filial piety for three years and postponed the marriage until she was nineteen.
As soon as the filial piety period was over, the Xie family sent someone to take her to Beijing.
When she first entered Xie's house, her aunt treated her kindly, and her cousin Xie Zhen referred to her as "cousin"
, Xie Rong is even more gentle and considerate, and often teases her like he did when he was a child.
However, I don’t know from which day everything changed.
"Has my brother met Mrs. Lu from the Privy Councilor's family?"
She asked Xie Rong.
"Don't think too much about it, it's all spread by servants."
title_en: Chapter 1: Making a Wife a Concubine Chapter 2: Hardness Under Softness
